stem: An aqueous solution of copper(II) sulfate is a blue colour due to the presence of $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ complex ions.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction between $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ ions and $\text{NaOH(aq)}$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction between $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ ions and an excess of conc. $\text{HCl}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: If an excess of ammonia is added to a solution of $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ a deep blue solution containing $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$ complex ions is formed.

parts.label: (b)(i)
(b)(ii)
parts.text: Use your answer in (b)(i) to deduce whether each of these isomers is polar or non-polar.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: The numerical value of the stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$, of the $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$ complex ion is $1.40 \times 10^{13}$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Compare the stabilities of the $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ and $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$ complex ions. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Write an expression for the stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$, of the $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$ complex ion. State the units of the stability constant.

units =

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text:
In a particular solution the concentration of the $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$ complex ion is $0.0074\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ and the concentration of $\text{NH}_3$ is $0.57\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$.

Use your expression in (c)(iii) and the $K_{\text{stab}}$ value of $1.40 \times 10^{13}$ to calculate the concentration of the $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ complex ion in this solution.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Phenanthroline, $\text{C}_{12}\text{H}_8\text{N}_2$, and ethanedioate ions, $\text{C}_2\text{O}_4^{2-}$, are bidentate ligands.

Ruthenium(III) ions, $\text{Ru}^{3+}$, form an octahedral complex with phenanthroline and chloride ions. The complex ion contains two phenanthroline molecules.

Iron(III) ions, $\text{Fe}^{3+}$, form an octahedral complex with ethanedioate ions only.

Deduce the formula and charge of each of these complex ions.
